name: Sudan
value: Drones hit grid; 10 killed at fuel station
summary: Drone strikes cripple Sudan's power grid; fuel station strike kills 10 in South Kordofan
state: Drone strikes blamed on the RSF have hit Sudan's largest thermal plant and several substations since late October, cutting White Nile and North Kordofan off the grid (AP, 2 Nov). A drone strike on a fuel station in South Kordofan killed more than 10 civilians on 4 Nov (Darfur24; Sudan Tribune). The IPC warns of a growing risk of famine in Darfur and Kordofan; no talks are under way.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Aid agencies' appeals are the main route for public support.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes and famine risk spreading = Alert

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.

rubric.alert: Major sieges or massacres reported, or famine spreading to new areas.
